latest.title: 5 AWS Services Every College Student Should Know
latest.description: Cloud competency is positioned as the new professional literacy for students graduating in 2026, crucial for bridging theoretical knowledge with practical, deployable applications. The proposed roadmap focuses on five core Amazon Web Services - EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS and CloudFront - designed to accelerate project development and minimize infrastructure management overhead by covering scalable computing, durable storage, serverless execution and performance optimization via a CDN.

latest.title: Kiro — The Importance of Steering
latest.description: Steering files are the difference between an AI assistant that writes generic code and one that follows your team's conventions from the first generation. This post covers the why, the proof, and a step-by-step approach to building a steering package that cuts always-on context by 67% while producing code that passes PR review on the first try.

latest.title: Verbis Graph Engine for Pharma & Life Sciences: Turning Fragmented Documents into Connected Knowledge
latest.description: In many Pharma and Life Sciences organizations, critical knowledge exists, but it is scattered across documents, teams, and systems, making it difficult to access quickly and use effectively. When knowledge is fragmented, it becomes harder for teams to stay aligned and move efficiently across regulatory, clinical, quality, scientific, and operational work.

latest.title: Talk to Your Graph: Natural Language Queries on Amazon Neptune via MCP Server in Amazon Quick
latest.description: Querying graph databases has traditionally required specialized languages like Gremlin or opencypher. In this blog, I show how the Neptune MCP Server bridges Amazon Neptune with Amazon Quick, enabling users to explore complex graph relationships, traverse connected data, and uncover hidden insights — all through simple, natural language questions. No query language expertise required.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description: ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is an AI-powered claim verification platform built on AWS that verifies scientific claims against 1.2M+ peer-reviewed papers across 8 domains — and automatically fetches and permanently stores new papers from arXiv, PubMed, etc. when gaps are found, making the knowledge base self-growing with every query. From typed claims to YouTube videos and uploaded documents, ASET delivers evidence-backed trust scores in under 10 seconds.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator

Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Veloquity - The Agentic Evidence Intelligent Platform Turning Raw Feedback into Evidence-Driven Decisions
trending.description: Decisions don’t fail from too little data - they fail from too much noise. READ ON TO SEE HOW.
